TextEncodeKrea2OstrisEdit.name: TextEncodeKrea2OstrisEdit
TextEncodeKrea2OstrisEdit.description: Encode a prompt with optional reference images for a Krea 2 edit LoRA. Images are fed to the Qwen3-VL text encoder (needs a text encoder checkpoint that includes the vision weights) and, when a VAE is connected, attached as reference latents for Krea2OstrisEditModelPatch.
